# Quality standards

The limits a fish oil has to meet to be considered non-oxidised and
contaminant-compliant. GOED and Codex limits are voluntary in most markets;
the EU contaminant limits are binding.

| ID | Parameter | Limit | Applies to | Source | Note |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| QS-01 | Peroxide value | 5 meq O2/kg | Bulk and encapsulated fish oil | R23, R24 | GOED Monograph and Codex CXS 329-2017 |
| QS-02 | p-Anisidine value | 20 index | Bulk and encapsulated fish oil | R23, R24 | Not valid for flavoured oils |
| QS-03 | TOTOX | 26 index | Bulk and encapsulated fish oil | R23, R24 | Calculated as (2 x peroxide value) + p-anisidine value |
| QS-04 | Acid value | 3 mg KOH/g | Fish oil | R24 | Codex CXS 329-2017 |
| QS-05 | Mercury (food supplements) | 0.1 mg/kg | Food supplements | R33 | EU maximum level |
| QS-06 | Dioxins | 1.75 pg WHO-TEQ/g fat | Marine oils for final consumer | R33 | EU maximum level |
| QS-07 | Dioxins plus dioxin-like PCBs | 6 pg WHO-PCDD/F-PCB-TEQ/g fat | Marine oils for final consumer | R33 | EU maximum level |
| QS-08 | Non-dioxin-like PCBs (ICES-6) | 200 ng/g fat | Marine oils for final consumer | R33 | EU maximum level |
| QS-09 | Mercury | 0.1 mg/kg | Fish oil | R35 | Industry specification; measured mean 0.0005 mg/kg across 792 samples |
| QS-10 | Polychlorinated biphenyls | 90 ppb | Fish oil | R35 | Industry specification |
| QS-11 | Dioxins | 3 pg TEQ/g | Fish oil | R35 | Industry specification |
